evidence_quotes: Eleda Norge AS, part of Eleda Group (”Eleda”), has signed an agreement to acquire Nordic Infrastructure Group AS
These operations will be part of Eleda Rail, which consolidates Eleda’s railway maintenance activities.
data.reason: The article reports on an acquisition made by the parent company, Eleda Group, and its subsidiary Eleda Norge AS. While the target entity Eleda Rail Norge AS is part of the Eleda Rail division, the news concerns the parent group's strategic acquisition of a third-party entity.
